arguments.value: Two infant cases of congenital atrioventricular block requiring permanent pacing. One 21-month-old girl with second-degree AV block underwent right ventricular septal transvenous endocardial pacing with SelectSecure 3830 lead and had stable lead parameters and normal growth over 5 years. One 8-month-old boy with third-degree AV block and ASD initially received epicardial pacing, but rising thresholds and impending battery depletion led to conversion to transvenous 3830 endocardial pacing at age 2 years, with good short- and long-term outcomes over 3 years. The report reviews indications, technical considerations, and risks of endocardial vs epicardial pacing in infants.
